title: Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE)
content: Part of the School of Science and Engineering. Offers BSc in CSE and MSc in CSE. Core academic subjects include programming, data structures & algorithms, database systems, operating systems, computer networks, software engineering, and artificial intelligence. Potential career paths (general guidance, not guaranteed): Software Engineer, Web/Mobile Developer, Data Analyst/AI Engineer, Network/Cloud Engineer, QA Specialist. Recommended skills: Python, TypeScript/Java, SQL, Git, cloud fundamentals, and problem-solving.
program_name: BSc in Computer Science and Engineering

title: Department of Business Administration
content: Part of the School of Business Administration. Offers BBA, Regular MBA, MBA for BBA Graduates, and Executive MBA with majors in Accounting, Finance, Marketing, HRM, and MIS. Potential career paths (general guidance): Financial Analyst, Corporate Banker, Brand/Digital Marketer, HR Business Partner, Supply Chain & Operations Coordinator. Recommended skills: Financial modeling, Excel/BI analytics, communication, leadership, and digital marketing.

title: Department of Civil Engineering
content: Part of the School of Civil, Environment and Industrial Engineering. Offers BSc in Civil Engineering with focus on structural analysis, geotechnical engineering, transportation, surveying, and environmental systems. Potential career paths (general guidance): Structural Engineer, Site/Project Engineer, Urban & Transport Planner, Construction Manager. Recommended skills: AutoCAD, ETABS/STAAD.Pro, surveying, project estimation.
school: School of Civil, Environment and Industrial Engineering

title: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE)
content: Part of the School of Science and Engineering. Offers BSc in EEE covering circuits, power generation and distribution, electronics, VLSI, control systems, and telecommunications. Potential career paths (general guidance): Power Systems Engineer, Electronics/Embedded Engineer, Telecom Engineer, Industrial Automation Engineer.
program_name: BSc in Electrical and Electronic Engineering

title: Department of Textile Engineering
content: Part of the School of Civil, Environment and Industrial Engineering. Offers BSc in Textile Engineering focused on yarn, fabric, wet processing, garment manufacturing, and industrial compliance in Bangladesh's RMG and textile sector.
school: School of Civil, Environment and Industrial Engineering

title: Department of English
content: Part of the School of Arts and Social Science. Offers BA (Hons) in English and MA programs in English Literature and English Language Teaching (ELT). Potential career paths (general guidance): Academic/ELT Instructor, Corporate Communications, Content & Editorial Specialist, Media & Publishing, Civil Service.
school: School of Arts and Social Science

title: Department of Law
content: Part of the School of Arts and Social Science. Offers LLB (Hons) and LLM (1 Year). Focuses on constitutional law, jurisprudence, civil/criminal procedure, international law, and corporate law. Potential career paths (general guidance): Advocate (upon Bar Council enrollment), Corporate Legal Counsel, Judicial Service aspirant, Legal Researcher.
school: School of Arts and Social Science
